title: Motion
description: full = the ledger eases in and out of play, and a droplet miss or combo break flashes its count. reduced = entering and leaving still ease; no flashes. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Show what osu!'s HUD shows
description: Also show fruits, drops and droplets caught, accuracy (with the best accuracy still possible) and combo, which osu!'s HUD and lazer's judgement counter already show. Give the page a taller box (256×192) when this is on. Droplets missed and combo breaks are always shown.

title: Orientation
description: auto = whichever shows the ledger larger in its box: side by side in wide boxes (the default slot), stacked in tall ones.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the ledger hugs inside its page. left for the left side of the screen (the default slot); right mirrors it (combo breaks on the outer edge) for the right side.
